newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen boosted by PPI data.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen boosted by PPI data.

text.p: U.S. stocks were expected to open higher on Thursday, boosted by Producer Price Index figures that showed a mild rise in the core December prices.
The U.S. Treasury 30-year bond was up 12/32 to yield 6.81, easing off a leap higher just after release of the figures. The Standard & Poors 500 futures index was up 1.30 to 756.90.
The Labor Department said prices rose 0.5 percent in December, with the crucial core rate, which excludes fuel and food, up 0.1 percent.
